project_type: React 19 SPA with Vite, TailwindCSS 4, and shadcn/ui components
test_framework: No test framework configured in the frontend project
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` (which runs `tsc -b && vite build`) to confirm all TypeScript compiles and Vite bundles without errors.
environment_constraints: Internet access available. React 19 compiler is enabled -- no manual useMemo/useCallback/React.memo. All CSS colors must use theme variables (var(--token)). No inline object/array literals in JSX.
contribution_requirements: Follow rules.md: React 19 compiler patterns, no manual memoization (3 exceptions only), forms use uncontrolled inputs with FormData, state local, server state via TanStack Query, sentence case everywhere, module-level constants for objects/arrays, mono font for developer-facing data.
key_patterns: Pages live in src/pages/workspaces/. Module logic (API, hooks, components) lives in src/modules/projects/. Shared UI primitives are in src/shared/ui/pulse/ (surfaces, metrics, controls) and src/shared/observe/. Design system follows sentinel-design-system.md (three-channel color separation: indigo=brand, green=truth, cyan=AI). Layout uses the 'Pulse surface kit' with PageHero, Panel, SectionHeading, StatCard, Pill, IconChip, etc. Project pages are wrapped in ProjectShellPage (provides context and ProjectHeaderBar). All project routes are nested under /projects/:projectId/.
directory_structure: src/pages/workspaces/ contains all project page components. src/modules/projects/ contains api/, hooks/, components/, navigation/. src/shared/ui/pulse/ has shared UI primitives. src/shared/observe/ has shared observe primitives (Table, Timestamp, formatters). src/components/ui/ has shadcn base components. src/app/router/ has route definitions.
